title: Look at the Stars!
traveler_why: Scout is the Seeker who loves to look up and ask what could be out there, and tonight’s psalm begins with a person looking up at a sky full of stars and asking a big question, then finding the answer: the One who made them all still knows and loves each child.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because a seeker looks up and wonders. Tonight’s psalm begins with a person under a wide night sky, so full of stars that it made him ask a big question. Scout loves big questions. And the answer the psalm-writer found is the best thing Scout could ever discover: the One who made every star still knows and loves each child.
